about_subtitle: Your modern and powerful video downloading tool
about_mission_text: MARIHAR was created with one simple goal: making video downloading accessible to everyone without compromising quality. We believe you should be able to enjoy your favorite content anytime and anywhere.
about_tech_text: Powered by yt-dlp, one of the world’s leading video downloading tools, MARIHAR provides a modern and intuitive interface while preserving the full power of command-line technology.
about_security_text: Your data stays yours. MARIHAR runs locally on your device and never sends information to external servers.
about_multilang_text: Download videos in any language. MARIHAR automatically detects all available audio tracks and subtitles.
guide_subtitle: Step-by-step guide to mastering all features
step1_text: Paste a video URL or simply type a title to search, just like on a search engine. Use the "Paste" button to automatically retrieve an URL from your clipboard.
step1_tip: Tip: MARIHAR works with links, song/artist titles, and even multi-platform playlists.
step2_text: Click the ANALYZE button to retrieve all information about the video. MARIHAR will automatically detect:
step3_text: Select the formats that best suit your needs:
step3_li3: Subtitles: Select the subtitle languages to download
step3_tip: Tip: Combined formats are recommended for smooth playback without synchronization issues.
step4_text: Customize your download with advanced options:
step4_li1: Burn subtitles: Embed subtitles directly into the video
step4_li2: Extract audio: Download only the audio track in MP3 format
step4_li3: Section: Download only a specific part of the video
step5_text1: Click the DOWNLOAD button and wait while the file downloads. A progress bar will display the progress in real time.
step5_text2: Once completed, your file will be available in the "Downloaded Files" section.

ytdlp_page_subtitle: Manage your yt-dlp version and configure your video downloader
ytdlp_what_desc: yt-dlp is the most powerful and up-to-date video download engine in the world. It enables MARIHAR to download videos from YouTube, TikTok, Instagram and hundreds of other platforms.
ytdlp_why_desc: Video platforms constantly change their algorithms and protections. Regular yt-dlp updates ensure you can always download your favorite videos without errors.
ytdlp_custom_page_desc: You can use your own yt-dlp version if you wish. This is useful if you need specific features or prefer to manage updates yourself.
ytdlp_config_desc: The yt-dlp configuration menu allows you to update, choose a custom version or reset to default in a few clicks. Everything is designed to be simple and intuitive.
ytdlp_step_1: Click on the yt-dlp configuration icon in the navigation bar
ytdlp_step_2: Choose "Auto Update" to update your current version
ytdlp_step_3: Choose "Select custom yt-dlp file" to use your own version
ytdlp_step_4: Choose "Reset to default" to return to the built-in version
ytdlp_tip_1: Update yt-dlp regularly to avoid download errors
ytdlp_tip_2: Auto update is blocking, wait for it to complete
ytdlp_tip_3: Use the built-in version if you don't need special features
ytdlp_tip_4: Update logs are displayed in a console window
